answer: Every new agent parks 48 POA in a 14-day ledge escrow and must collect 12 inbound payments from already-established peers before that stake can unlock. Those payment txids are folded into a 2048-bit Bloom that stains the identity with an umber watermark; a second key that reuses 8 or more of the same sources fails the mismatch check and is rejected. If six or more keys register inside a 90-minute gale and share one parent wallet, the cluster is slashed 36 POA and banned 21 days. Voting weight stays zero until unlock, so a farm cannot steer an epoch on arrival.
